# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

## Bovogen Biologicals Pty Ltd is an Australian Biotech company located in Melbourne.

 

Bovogen Biologicals is a division of ANZCO Foods Healthcare, dedicated to the research, development,
manufacture and supply of high quality animal serums, purified animal proteins and other specialty
biotech products.

 

Bovogen Biologicals core products include Foetal Bovine Serum, Newborn Calf Serum, Bovine Serum
Albumin and specialty products. Complimentary to meeting the varied needs of our customers, we
provide contract lyophilisation and bioprocessing services for biological derived products.

 

Bovogen Biologicals global customer footprint covers five continents and incorporates more than
forty five countries worldwide. With the continued growth and global demand for our products, we
regard this as testament and recognition of our internationally recognised and accredited
manufacturing standards, outstanding product quality and highly valued customer service excellence.

 

Bovogen Biologicals products are used by a large diversity of customers to include; vaccine and
bio-pharmaceutical manufacturers, medical and veterinary research institutes, human and veterinary
diagnostics, human nutraceutical and nutrition companies.

About us
Hangzhou Clongene Biotech Co., Ltd.

Founded in 2004, Hangzhou Clongene Biotech Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise specializing
in providing Biological Raw Materials, Diagnostic Reagents, and CRO/CDMO Services. 22 years of
experience in the diagnostic industry, we have been committed to providing customers with
high-quality products and professional technical services. Based on the platform of protein
expression and antibody preparation, Clongene has developed antigens, antibodies and molecular
diagnostic enzymes in the fields of infectious diseases, drugs of abuse, fertility, tumor markers,
inflammation, food safety and veterinary diseases. After preparation, purification and verification,
the biological raw materials can be applied to immunochromatography, ELISA, chemiluminescence and
PCR. We can also provide customized services for biological raw materials according to customer
needs. After 20 years of innovation and development, Clongene has developed colloidal gold/latex
detection reagents, fluorescent immunoassay detection reagents, chemiluminescence detection reagents
and PCR detection reagents. The main IVD reagents have obtained authoritative certifications
including NMPA of China, FDA of US and CE of EU. The products were sold well in more than 100
countries and regions around the world. Clongene is committed to bringing more value to companies
and units around the world with a wealth of products and professional services, and to bring more
opportunities for distributors and partners.

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

**DK Enzymes & Chemicals** is one of the leading supplier of diagnostic, pharmaceuticals, and
research products in India since 2011. Company is in business of import and export of various

substrate, HbA1c, human proteins, antibodies, gold conjugate, and many more.

diagnostic reagent manufacturing and used for immunodiagnostic assays such as EIA, RIA, and ELISA
blocking systems. It is also a model protein used for blood banking reagents.

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

macromolecules in solution at a resolution of 1-2 nm.
